description: This file contains the code-behind logic for the Leaderboard page in an online examination system. It manages session validation, retrieves user semester information from the database, and handles navigation actions via button clicks.

classes.name: Leaderboard
classes.description: A partial class representing the code-behind of the Leaderboard ASP.NET page, managing session validation, database interaction, and navigation logic.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load events; verifies user session, retrieves user semester info from database, and stores it in session.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Navigates user to the Dashboard page when the home button is clicked.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Navigates user to the UserProfile page when the profile button is clicked.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Placeholder for leaderboard button click event; currently no action.
